why.title: One partner from site plan to handover

items.title: Free layout suggestion
items.text: Share your site plan or amenity area. We suggest a play layout that fits the space, the age groups and your budget.

items.title: Committee-ready proposal
items.text: You get design renders, a budget estimate and an installation plan, ready to present to your management or society committee.

items.title: Made in our own factory
items.text: Everything is manufactured at our 45,000 sq. ft. facility in Vasai, so quality and timelines stay in our hands.

items.title: Built for Indian weather
items.text: Galvanized pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, chosen for years of outdoor use.

items.title: 3-year structural warranty
items.text: 3 years on galvanized pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. 1 year on springs and bearings.

items.title: Installation that fits your timeline
items.text: Delivery and installation coordinated with your construction schedule, with after-sales support after handover.

ranges.title: Play structures for every amenity space

tabs.name: NexLev Series
tabs.blurb: Wooden play structures: pinnacle towers, castles and adventure sets for large communities and campuses.

tabs.name: CoreCraft
tabs.blurb: Themed multi-play stations (castles, circus, jungle, robots), plus individual swings, slides, see-saws and spring riders.

tabs.name: FunPlay Originals
tabs.blurb: Our own designs, inspired by Indian play, nature and paper craft. Each one invites children to invent their own games.
